title: A tip calculator
description:
Work out a tip and split a bill.

```
Bill: 84.50
Tip %: 15
People: 4
Tip: 12.68
Each pays: 24.29
```
hints: `decimal tip = bill * tipPercent / 100m;` keeps everything in `decimal`, which is what money should use (lesson 1.02).
requirements: Read the bill as a `decimal` and the other two as `int` with `decimal.Parse` and `int.Parse`.
Zero people prints `Nobody to split with` instead of dividing.
stretch: Use `decimal.TryParse` so typing `abc` prints a message instead of crashing.
